meaning: The impeller is not spinning normally. LG says this can happen when the impeller does not spin or when dishes touch it.
diySteps: Reorganize the dishes so nothing touches the impeller
If nE appears again, request LG service
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the error persists after the dishes are rearranged, LG says inspection by a service technician is necessary. A different LG code, LE, points to the cleaning motor and also needs a technician.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
